title: record:details draws a read-only boolean as text (开启 / 关闭), not a disabled checkbox that reads as a broken setting (ruling B on cloud#2774 Q3)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 4, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's ruling Q3 B on objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 (batch #362 item 5, 「其他同意」; the ruling record is that card's `Ruled:` line) under the standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」. ⛔ Not a claim. Filing gate ①: a measured usability defect on every record page.

## What is measured (cloud#2916 Target 2, the cloud seat's reading on the pin)
- `record:details` lists fields by name (spec `component.zod.ts:1357`); a read-only boolean renders as the console's checkbox, which the 2026-10-16 walk read as 「a setting that cannot be clicked」 on the environment detail's 访问与登录 section. The empty-field fold is `DetailSection`'s own (objectui#7129 Q2-C) and stays.

## Scope
1. In `record:details`, a boolean field the viewer cannot edit draws as text (开启 / 关闭, i18n), not as a disabled checkbox; editable booleans unchanged.
2. The empty-field fold is unchanged (objectui#7129 Q2-C).
3. `Clause-②: no`.

## Done when
- A test: a read-only boolean in a details section renders the text; an editable one renders the control.
- cloud#2916 Target 2's section can be declared as written.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 (Q3), #2916; objectui#7129.
